messages:
incidents-bot: SEV2 paging -> routing-service high tail latency + 502s in ap-southeast-1. Error spike started ~08:14 UTC. Paging @Anya

Anya: Ack. pulling traces and route maps now. Can someone confirm if recent split-route canary went live?

Tom W.: I pushed the canary for split-route weighting at 08:10. small % of traffic (5%) to new logic. No other infra changes.

Nikhil Rao: Im seeing a rapid increase in per-route queue length in the proxy layer for the canary bucket. Queueing -> timeouts -> 502s.

ops_maya: Ops note: we have spike of SYN backlog on the front proxies; increasing proxy workers to buy time.

Anya: good. Can we temporarily stop routing to the canary?

Tom W.: flipping canary traffic to 0 now (cmd):
```bash
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane/api/route/canary -d '{"weight":0}'
```

debug-bot: Action logged: canary-weight set to 0. Changes propagated in ~25s.

Nikhil Rao: after flip, 502 rate dropped from 9% to 1.5% within a minute. Latency p99 improved but queue length still elevated on some proxies.

ops_maya: scaling proxy workers complete (cmd):
```bash
kubectl scale deploy/proxy --replicas=12 -n prod-apse1
```

Anya: thanks. Any sign of resource exhaustion (CPU/mem)?

Tom W.: no CPU OOMs. We saw high socket usage and a backlog of half-closed connections; suspect the new route selection occasionally created hotspot fans to older upstream targets.

Ellen (product): any customer-visible impact beyond the 502s? support has a small set of tickets for timed-out requests. Nothing escalated to infra SLA yet.

Anya: Post-incident plan: immediate mitigation done. Ill own the postmortem and timeline. Need an owner for remediation of the route selector algorithm and for canary guardrails.

Tom W.: Ill own the route selector fix. I want to add deterministic hashing when fallback occurs so we avoid hot fans.

Nikhil Rao: Ill own proxy observability changes: add per-canary queue depth metrics and socket backlog alerts.

ops_maya: ops will add an automated rollback hook in the control plane to detach canary if queueing crosses threshold. Ill open PRs today.

Anya: Customer comms: Ellen, can you draft a short note for the impacted tenants (ap-southeast) and mark support as standby?

Ellen (product): Yes, will prepare a templated note. Also checking billing/seat implications; will flag any anomalies.

debug-bot: Postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/1865432100-routing-canary-skew (private)

Anya: Postmortem skeleton Im adding:
- brief incident summary and timeline
- impact: p95/p99 numbers + affected routes/tenants
- root cause hypothesis: fallback path + hash instability + canary weighting edge-case
- mitigations and rollback timeline
- action items with owners and due dates
- follow-ups: brown-bag + runbook updates

Tom W.: Proposed actions:
- stabilize fallback hashing (owner: Tom) due 72h
- create canary preflight tests simulating skew (owner: Tom) due 5d
- control-plane automated detach on queue threshold (owner: ops_maya) due 48h
- per-canary proxy metrics + alert (owner: Nikhil) due 48h
- customer comms draft and support follow-up (owner: Ellen) due EOD

Nikhil Rao: ETA notes: metrics + alerts 48-72h, will push dashboards and alert rules in a single PR.

ops_maya: Ill prototype the control-plane detach logic today and aim to get it reviewed by tomorrow.

Ellen (product): Comms draft ready in ~3 hours. Will include what we know, mitigations taken, and next steps.

Anya: Scheduling: Lets do a quick postmortem review (30m) and then an org brown-bag to share prevention patterns and canary best practices. Suggested slots:
- Postmortem review: Tue 09:30 UTC
- Brown-bag: Thu 16:00 UTC (30-45m)
Poll: https://calendar.polls/internal/1865432100

Tom W.: Tue 09:30 works. I can present the route selector change and the deterministic hashing plan.

Nikhil Rao: Thu brown-bag good for me. Ill demo the new metric dashboards during the session.

ops_maya: Will add a short runbook snippet to run immediate canary-detach steps and how to scale proxies quickly. Will PR to docs repo after postmortem.

Anya: Ill assign action items in the postmortem doc and start the timeline. Please update your task status as you make progress; Ill follow up daily.

Ellen (product): Support channel standby and legal review queued if any billing adjustments are required.

debug-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Tasks created in tracker: RT-4256, RT-4257, RT-4258.

Tom W.: Quick wins Ill do today: add a unit test to simulate route fallback and a small canary skew test harness.

Nikhil Rao: Ill add a low-threshold alert for per-canary queue depth so we detect early next time.

ops_maya: Thanks team. Good coordination. Recording scheduled for brown-bag.

Anya: Thanks everyone. Ill post the final postmortem link and invites once times are locked. Closing thread for now; reopen if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
